story_title: Virgo Transport 8 ferry capsizes in Java Sea, 129 missing

sources.exact_quote: Four dead victims were evacuated today from a vessel near the accident site and flown to Sjamsudin Noor Air Base,
Besides supporting air operations, Sjamsudin Noor Air Base is an important point for receiving and evacuating victims found in the Java Sea,
